title: Construction Matrix
text: Creates Void Crystals at the spell impact, normally lasting twenty seconds. Enhancement strengthens them and raises blast resistance; each Delay doubles their lifetime, while Infusion makes them permanent. Use a staff to left-click them away.
On creatures, construction locks movement and actions for 5 seconds. Delay doubles this duration, Enhancement adds crushing damage, and Infusion allows the locked creature to be mined.
Mining difficulty depends on the creature's health. Finish mining before the lock expires to kill it; the tool's Fortune is treated as Looting for drops.
